title: Pocketwire Business Profile: Number of Profiles per Owner
content:
**Clause.** A customer may hold up to 3 Pocketwire Business Profiles that are not closed, each with its own name, balance and tier. A further profile is opened only if the customer holds fewer than 3 business profiles whose status is anything other than closed.

The statuses that count toward the 3 are applied, active, under review and suspended. Closed profiles do not count. The count is read from the customer's business profile records, not from the customer's account of them, and each further profile carries a name of its own.

| Profiles the customer already holds that are not closed | Can a further profile be opened? |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | yes |
| 3 | no |

**Cases (hypothetical holdings).**
- Two active profiles and one closed profile: two count, so a further profile can be opened.
- One active, one under review and one suspended profile: three count, so no further profile can be opened.
- A profile still in applied status counts in the same way as an active one.
